whenToUse: An HR employee file: identity, reporting line, pay, leave balance, documents and reviews.
Requesting or withdrawing leave with working-day counts from the employee's page.
avoidWhen: Team-wide headcount and leave — use dashboard-07.
Managing users and permissions — use users-roles-01.
a11y: Pay stays hidden until revealed via a pressed toggle; a role="status" region reports changes.
Leave rings are role="img" — always show the numeric balance as text.
